semiconductor_relevance: High — The company provides high-performance polymer solutions and sealing products essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Saint-Gobain Advanced Materials (Taiwan) Co., Ltd. specializes in high-performance polymer solutions for the semiconductor industry. Their offerings include Furon® valves and fittings for fluid handling, Meldin® polyimide materials for high-temperature applications, and Omniseal® seals for reliable insulation, catering to LCD, LED, and photovoltaic segments.

regional_presence.Taiwan: The company operates in Taiwan, focusing on high-performance materials for the semiconductor industry.
